subtasks.title: Secure JWT Storage
subtasks.description: Implement secure storage of JWT tokens using HttpOnly cookies to prevent XSS attacks and ensure session security.
subtasks.details:
Configure server to set HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite cookie attributes. Ensure client-side code does not access JWT directly and validate cookie handling in all environments.
<info added on 2025-08-04T05:45:44.387Z>
Implemented JWT cookie configuration across authentication endpoints (/api/auth/login, /api/auth/logout, /api/auth/refresh, /api/auth/me). Cookies set with following security parameters: httpOnly: true, secure flag enabled in production, sameSite: 'lax'. Access tokens configured with 1-hour expiration, refresh tokens with 30-day expiration. Added authentication middleware to protect routes and validate tokens. Middleware checks cookie presence, validates JWT signature, and handles token expiration scenarios. Route protection implemented with role-based access control support.
</info added on 2025-08-04T05:45:44.387Z>

subtasks.title: Token Refresh Mechanism
subtasks.description: Implement automatic JWT token refresh to maintain session validity without user interruption.
subtasks.details:
Set up refresh endpoint, schedule refresh before token expiry, and update auth context state on refresh. Handle refresh failures gracefully.
<info added on 2025-08-04T05:58:39.806Z>
Implemented JWT refresh mechanism in AuthContext using 45-minute interval scheduling. Refresh process calls apiClient.refreshToken() automatically before the 1-hour token expiry window. Refresh timer initialization occurs after successful login and initial session load. Timer cleanup is handled during sign out and component unmount events. Added security measure to force sign out if token refresh fails. Refresh mechanism maintains continuous session validity without user intervention while ensuring secure token rotation.
</info added on 2025-08-04T05:58:39.806Z>
